title: Thalipeeth
subtitle: A multigrain flatbread of jowar, besan, and wheat, patted straight onto the tawa.
meta: Night prep: mix dry flour blend
protein: ~18–22g protein per adult (2 thalipeeths) — besan + jowar + wheat combined

nightPrep.label: Night Before
items: Mix {@jowar}, {@besan}, {@wheat} and {@rice-flour} into the bhajani blend and store in a jar — lasts months, make a big batch
Mix dough the night before with all additions; refrigerate wrapped in damp cloth

method.title: Mix dough (night before)
items: Add {@water:mix} gradually; mix into a soft pliable dough — add {@water:more}
Set aside toddler portion {=¼ cup dough} before adding green chili to adult dough
Add {@green-chili} to adult dough; knead briefly
Wrap both portions in damp cloth; refrigerate

method.label: Toddler dough
items: Her ¼ cup portion is already chili-free — same flour blend, same spices except green chili
Make 1–2 smaller, thinner thalipeeths for her — thinner = softer when cooked
Cook on medium-low; add {@butter:toddler} on top while warm

method.title: Cook (morning)
items: Remove dough from fridge; let sit 5 min at room temperature
Keep {@water-hands|a small bowl of water} nearby and wet your palm — thalipeeth dough is patted directly onto the tawa, not rolled
Place a ball of dough {=slightly larger than a golf ball} on a greased medium-hot tawa
Pat out gently with wet fingers into a thin round circle {=~6–7 in}; make 3–4 small holes in the surface with your finger
Drizzle {@ghee:holes} into the holes and around the edges
Cook on medium 3–4 min until underside is golden; flip carefully
Drizzle {@ghee:flip} on the other side; cook 2–3 min more

method.label: Tip
method.text: Wet hands are essential — thalipeeth dough is sticky and can't be rolled with a pin. Keep a small bowl of water nearby and re-wet between each one.
